text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text: Huh... Hey, wait. You know... The atmosphere around here has changed a lot, hasn't it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれ……
ちょー、待って。
なんかさ……
この辺、
何気に空気変わったくね？

text_block_list.name: Yuni
text_block_list.text: Wh-What's with this ominous bell?! This is bad! Hide, everyone!
text_block_list.orig_text:
むっ、
この不吉な鐘の音は……！？　
まずい、
隠れろ諸君！

text_block_list.name: Tomie
text_block_list.orig_text:
♪せーんと　
てれさー　
じょーがくいーんー……

text_block_list.name: Chieru
text_block_list.text: Eeek! The Demon Lord I thought I’d defeated is walking normally with a cool face!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ひえっ！
倒したはずの魔王が、
涼しい顔してフツーに歩ってる！

text_block_list.name: Tomie
text_block_list.text: Where did the jailbreakers go...? Ahhh, as soon as they find them, they'll be be beheaded, and the severed heads will be kicked into each other's hands. Bwahaha!
text_block_list.orig_text:
どこ行きゃあがった〝脱獄囚〟ら……
あァー、
見つけ次第〝斬首刑〟にして、
切り落とした〝生首〟蹴り合う〝球技〟でもしてえなァ、
ぶははは！

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text: Crap, she's back to normal. Her skin's so glossy. Just how much did that battle give her for the first time?
text_block_list.orig_text:
やべー、
ピンピンしてンじゃん。
お肌つやつやじゃん。
さっきのバトル、
どんだけ初回接待だったんだよ。

text_block_list.name: Yuni
text_block_list.text: This is bad. I have to hurry in two ways. I can't let Sister Tomie catch me right now, and if it drags on too long, the Guild Management Association will start complaining about me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
これはまずい、
二重の意味で急がねば。
今シスター・トミヱに捕まるわけにはいかんし、
長引けば
ギルド管理協会からもねちねち言われるぞ。

text_block_list.name: Chieru
text_block_list.text: Right? Anyway, let's hurry to the Flying Chielun!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ですね、
とにかく
『フライングちぇるーん号』へ急ぎましょう！

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text: Was that the name of Medan’s airship?
text_block_list.orig_text:
メ団の飛空艇、
そんな名前だったっけ。
